name: Fatima Spagogo
label: Food delivery
greeting: Hello. Ask about the menu, prices or delivery areas. I can also check an order with its reference and phone number.

scheduled.label: Scheduled
scheduled.explanation: The order was placed outside opening hours, so it is scheduled for the next opening time. The kitchen has not started it yet.

received.label: Received
received.explanation: Payment is confirmed and the kitchen has your order.

preparing.label: Preparing
preparing.explanation: The kitchen is preparing your food now.

out_for_delivery.label: Out for delivery
out_for_delivery.explanation: Your order has left the kitchen and is on its way to you.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.explanation: This order was cancelled. If you did not ask for this, message us on WhatsApp.

refusals: no delivery outside Ibafo and Mowe
